info.title: DAS Tag Manager API
info.description: DAS Tag Manager for one Network (containers and tags follow). Served on the Network host `<network>.tag-manager.<org domain>`. Conventions (docs/engineering/api-conventions.md): JSON in camelCase, instants in `*At` fields as ISO-8601 UTC, ids as prefixed ULIDs. Errors are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` with a machine `code`. Authentication is an Organization session token bound to a Network; the Network a request acts for is ALWAYS the credential's, and the host must name it (403 `NETWORK_HOST_MISMATCH`). 401 and 403 problems apply to every authenticated operation; 503 `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE` when the Organisation API, which answers for the credential's Network, does not.

dataSources.name: audit_events

dataSources.name: audit_event
dataSources.description: One row of the audit trail of the credential's Network in DAS Tag Manager.

dataSources.name: mobile_config_releases
dataSources.description: The releases of the Network's mobile configuration (the feature `mobile-config`), newest first, without their sources, filtered by app and environment (every page followed).

dataSources.name: mobile_config_release
dataSources.description: One release of the Network's mobile configuration (the feature `mobile-config`), with its source as published.

actions.name: mobile_config_release
actions.description: Publishes a release of an app's mobile configuration for one environment (the feature `mobile-config`), as a Network admin: compiled, signed and numbered after the last release of the app and environment. A release is immutable, so publishing is an action, not a resource: every invocation is a new release.

ads_enabled.description: Master switch for ad rendering in the app.

actions.name: mobile_config_release_rollback
actions.description: Rolls an app's mobile configuration back to an earlier release (the feature `mobile-config`), as a Network admin: its source is republished as the next release of the app and environment, signed anew.

servers.description: A Network host of the tag-manager module, `<network>.tag-manager.<org domain>`

tags.name: audit

bearer.description: An Organization session token (Cognito access token) bound to one Network.

AuditActorFilter.name: actor
AuditActorFilter.description: Only rows of this actor, exactly: `human:<email>`, `service:<apiKeyName>` or `agent:<name>/<session>`.

AuditActionFilter.name: action
AuditActionFilter.description: Only rows of this action, exactly, e.g. `api-key.create`.

AuditResourceTypeFilter.name: resourceType
AuditResourceTypeFilter.description: Only rows about this kind of resource, e.g. `api-key`.

AuditResourceIdFilter.name: resourceId
AuditResourceIdFilter.description: Only rows about this resource, by its id.

AuditChannelFilter.name: channel
AuditChannelFilter.description: Only rows that came through this channel.

AuditFromFilter.name: from
AuditFromFilter.description: Only rows that occurred at or after this ISO-8601 instant.

AuditToFilter.name: to
AuditToFilter.description: Only rows that occurred before this ISO-8601 instant.

AuditExportFrom.name: from
AuditExportFrom.description: The start of the window, an ISO-8601 instant (inclusive).

AuditExportTo.name: to
AuditExportTo.description: The end of the window, an ISO-8601 instant (exclusive), after `from` and at most 92 days later.

AuditFromSeq.name: fromSeq
AuditFromSeq.description: The first link to verify (default 1, the genesis).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key, 1-255 printable ASCII characters (a UUID is fine). A retry with the same key and request replays the first response; the same key with a different request is 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page, passed back unchanged. Omit it for the first page.

MobileConfigReleaseIdPath.name: releaseId
MobileConfigReleaseIdPath.description: The release, `mcrel_<ULID>`. One of another Network is 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

SiteCodeFilter.name: siteCode
SiteCodeFilter.description: Only releases of this app, UPPER_SNAKE (e.g. `ONET_IOS`).

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Correlation id, 1-128 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`; echoed in the response. A malformed or missing one is replaced by `req_<ULID>`.

XRequestId.description: The request id: the client's well-formed X-Request-Id, else a generated `req_<ULID>`.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is the stored response of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

ValidationFailed.description: The request is not valid (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, `MALFORMED_JSON`, `INVALID_CURSOR`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID`): an unknown query parameter, a malformed value, or a source that does not compile

SigningUnavailable.description: The installation has no signing key for mobile configuration (`NOT_CONFIGURED`), or the Organisation API did not answer for the credential's Network (`UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`)

Forbidden.description: The credential may not do this (`NO_ACCESS`, `INSUFFICIENT_ROLE`, `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`, `NETWORK_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED`, `NETWORK_HOST_MISMATCH`, `FEATURE_DISABLED`)

UpstreamUnavailable.description: The Organisation API did not answer for the credential's Network (`UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`)

InternalError.description: An unexpected failure (`INTERNAL_ERROR`); the request id names it in the service's logs

Money.description: An amount of money: a decimal string (never a JSON number) and its ISO-4217 currency.

siteCode.description: The app the release is for, UPPER_SNAKE, 1-64 characters (e.g. `ONET_IOS`); signed into the bundle as its app id

environment.description: The app's environment the release is for; signed into the bundle in lower case (`production`)

sourceFormat.description: The format of `source`: `DCFG_RULES_V1`, the rules document of segments and flags

source.description: The rules in `sourceFormat`. `DCFG_RULES_V1`: `{ segments?, flags }` - named reusable conditions and the flags by key, each with its `default`, optional `prerequisites` and targeting `rules` (docs/architecture/tag-manager-mobile-config.md "Authoring rules"). Nested at most 100 levels; no key `__proto__`; no U+0000 and no unpaired surrogate in a key or a string

MobileConfigReleaseCreate.description: A new release of an app's mobile configuration for one environment: compiled and signed at once, numbered after the last release of the app and environment.

AuditEvent.description: One row of an audit trail: one mutation (or a chain's genesis). Its `hash` is sha256(`prevHash` || RFC 8785 JSON of the record v1: every field here but `hash`, plus `v: 1`), lower-case hex.

id.description: The row, `aud_<ULID>` on a Network's trail, `orgaud_<ULID>` on the org layer's

chain.description: The chain the row is a link of: `org`, or `network:<networkId>`

seq.description: Its position in the chain, from 1 (the genesis) without gaps; null for a row written before the chain (sealed by the genesis)

prevHash.description: The hash of the link before (64 zeros for the genesis); null before the chain

hash.description: sha256(prevHash || RFC 8785 JSON of the record), lower-case hex; null before the chain

networkId.description: The Network whose trail it is; null on the org layer's

occurredAt.description: When the change committed, ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds

action.description: What was done, `<resource>.<verb>`, e.g. `api-key.create`; `audit-chain.genesis` for a chain's first link

requestId.description: The X-Request-Id of the request that made the change

reason.description: Why, when the operation records it

changes.description: What the mutation changed, one entry per row written; null before the chain. Empty for an act that changes no row (a test email)

channel.description: The door: the console, the das CLI (its User-Agent, a declaration), an API key, an AI agent, the identity provider over SCIM, or the platform itself

actorRole.description: The coarse role of the principal

actorRoles.description: The role names the principal held (GET /api/roles of the Organisation API describes each); empty for an API key

actorNetworkId.description: The Network the principal's credential is bound to; null for an Organization-level one

credentialKind.description: The kind of credential, never its secret

credentialId.description: The credential's id: an API key's `key_<ULID>`, an Organization API key's `okey_<ULID>`, a session's subject or token id, a SCIM token's `scimtok_<ULID>`

AuditChange.description: One row a mutation wrote: its model and id, the operation and the fields that changed.

fields.description: The changed fields by name: `{ before, after }` (a CREATE's before and a DELETE's after are null; instants ISO-8601, decimals as strings), or `{ redacted: true, changed }` for a secret, a hash or a secret reference, whose value is never recorded

AuditFieldChange.description: One changed field: its values, or only that a secret changed.

before.description: The value before; null when the row did not exist

after.description: The value after; null when the row is gone

oneOf.description: A secret, hash or secret reference: only whether it changed

AuditEventPage.description: One page of an audit trail, newest first.

items.description: The audit events of this page

AuditChainBreak.description: The first link that does not hold, and why.

seq.description: The seq where the chain breaks

reason.description: HASH_MISMATCH: a field changed behind the application; PREV_HASH_MISMATCH: a link does not name the one before; SEQ_GAP: a link was deleted; GENESIS_MISSING: the first link is no genesis; LEGACY_DIGEST_MISMATCH: a row before the chain changed; TRUNCATED: the newest links were deleted

AuditChainCheck.description: One verification of the chain the duty platform.audit-verify recorded.

fromSeq.description: The first link it verified (1 = the whole chain)

throughSeq.description: The last link it verified; 0 for an empty chain

headSeq.description: The chain's head when it ran

headHash.description: The head's hash when it ran (also logged by the duty, a witness outside the database)

breakSeq.description: The first link that did not hold; null when intact

breakReason.description: Why it did not hold (AuditChainBreak.reason); null when intact

AuditChain.description: The hash chain of a trail: its head and its last recorded verification.

headSeq.description: The newest link's seq; 0 while the chain is empty

headHash.description: The newest link's hash; null while the chain is empty

lastCheck.description: The newest verification; null while none ran

AuditChainVerification.description: A verification of one segment of the chain, computed now and recorded nowhere.

intact.description: Whether every link of the segment holds (and, from seq 1, the genesis seal)

checkedThroughSeq.description: The last seq verified without a break

nextFromSeq.description: Where the next segment starts; null at the head or at a break

firstBreak.description: The first link that does not hold; null when intact

Problem.description: RFC 7807 problem details. Branch on `code`, never on `title` or `detail`.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type

path.description: Dotted path inside the location; empty for the whole value

NextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page, opaque; null on the last page.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document, identical to the released artifact

get.summary: Who the credential is and its Network
List the Network's mobile configuration releases
get.description: Network-bound credential; any role holding the scope `das:tag-manager:mobile-config:read` (`VIEWER`, `OPERATOR`, `APPROVER`, `NETWORK_ADMIN`). Requires the feature `mobile-config` on for the Network (403 `FEATURE_DISABLED` otherwise). Newest first, without their sources (GET /api/mobile-config/releases/{releaseId} has the source).

post.description: Network-bound credential with the `ADMIN` role (`NETWORK_ADMIN`) and the scope `das:tag-manager:mobile-config:admin`, and the feature `mobile-config` on for the Network (403 `FEATURE_DISABLED` otherwise). The release is compiled and signed with the Organization's key at once (503 `NOT_CONFIGURED` when the installation has none) and numbered after the last release of its `siteCode` and `environment` (the first is 1); two publications racing for one app and environment get consecutive numbers. It is immutable: nothing updates or deletes it. A source the schema of its format or the compiler refuses is 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` at `source...`, and nothing is written. Audited as `mobile-config-release.create` (the bundle's bytes are redacted).

requestBody.description: The app, the environment and the source to publish

201.description: The published release (or, on a replay, the stored response)

get.description: Network-bound credential; any role holding the scope `das:tag-manager:mobile-config:read` (`VIEWER`, `OPERATOR`, `APPROVER`, `NETWORK_ADMIN`). Requires the feature `mobile-config` on for the Network (403 `FEATURE_DISABLED` otherwise). With its source as published.

post.summary: Roll back to a mobile configuration release
post.description: Network-bound credential with the `ADMIN` role (`NETWORK_ADMIN`) and the scope `das:tag-manager:mobile-config:admin`, and the feature `mobile-config` on for the Network (403 `FEATURE_DISABLED` otherwise). The release is compiled and signed with the Organization's key at once (503 `NOT_CONFIGURED` when the installation has none) and numbered after the last release of its `siteCode` and `environment` (the first is 1); two publications racing for one app and environment get consecutive numbers. It is immutable: nothing updates or deletes it. Republishes the source of the release named in the path as the next release of its `siteCode` and `environment`, signed anew, with `rolledBackFromId` naming it; that release stays as it was. No body. Audited as `mobile-config-release.rollback`.

201.description: The new release (or, on a replay, the stored response)

get.summary: Get the public key that signs mobile configuration
get.description: Network-bound credential; any role holding the scope `das:tag-manager:mobile-config:read` (`VIEWER`, `OPERATOR`, `APPROVER`, `NETWORK_ADMIN`). Requires the feature `mobile-config` on for the Network (403 `FEATURE_DISABLED` otherwise). The public half of the Organization's Ed25519 key; a bundle's signature covers `"dcfg-bundle-v1\0"` followed by its payload (docs/architecture/tag-manager-mobile-config.md). 503 `NOT_CONFIGURED` when the installation has no key.

get.summary: List the trail of the credential's Network
get.description: Network-bound credential with the scope `das:platform:audit:read` (the roles ORG_AUDITOR, AUDITOR and ORG_OWNER; no admin role holds it). Newest first; every filter narrows. Each row says what changed (`changes`), who acted with which role, Network and credential, through which channel, and its link in the hash chain.

200.description: One page of audit events, newest first

get.summary: Export the trail of the credential's Network as JSON Lines
get.description: Network-bound credential with the scope `das:platform:audit:read` (the roles ORG_AUDITOR, AUDITOR and ORG_OWNER; no admin role holds it). Every row that occurred in [from, to) - at most 92 days - one AuditEvent per line: the rows written before the chain first, then the links by seq, each with its seq, prevHash and hash, so the export is verifiable offline (sha256(prevHash || RFC 8785 JSON of the record), docs/engineering/api-conventions.md#audit).

200.description: JSON Lines (`application/x-ndjson`): one AuditEvent per line, nothing else

get.summary: Get one row of the trail of the credential's Network
get.description: Network-bound credential with the scope `das:platform:audit:read` (the roles ORG_AUDITOR, AUDITOR and ORG_OWNER; no admin role holds it).

get.summary: The hash chain of the trail of the credential's Network
get.description: Network-bound credential with the scope `das:platform:audit:read` (the roles ORG_AUDITOR, AUDITOR and ORG_OWNER; no admin role holds it). The chain's head and the last verification the duty platform.audit-verify recorded.

200.description: The chain's head and last verification

get.summary: Verify a segment of the hash chain of the trail of the credential's Network
get.description: Network-bound credential with the scope `das:platform:audit:read` (the roles ORG_AUDITOR, AUDITOR and ORG_OWNER; no admin role holds it). Recomputes the links [fromSeq, fromSeq + limit) now and writes nothing; continue at `nextFromSeq` until it is null.
